'''Quae-Na''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] who worked as a [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, he operated a stall on the [[Koss Overlook]] of the [[Gormak Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Quae-Na wore gray [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and carried staff while at his stall. He had blue and white skin and orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quae-Na first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].
